research:
Usage (2025-26, used because opening night has no 2026-27 sample): SGA 33.4% and Wembanyama 32.4% (Basketball-Reference), J. Williams 26.2% in 33 games, Fox 25.1% (Screwball), Ajay Mitchell ~24.3% (NBA.com Nov snapshot). Roles mostly unchanged; J. Williams returns and SA starts Harper, taking some Fox touches.
DvP (Rotogrinders FD, 2025-26 final; low rank number = most allowed): OKC vs C 27th, vs PG 16th, vs SF 21st; SA vs PG 25th, SG 30th, SF 30th, C 28th. No 24%+ usage player draws a bottom-10 defense, so no usage SGP qualifies today.
Best-possible SGP: SGA o28.5 pts (-122) + o3.5 reb (Kalshi 61c) + o5.5 ast (Polymarket 63c). No alt ladder prices published; 93% lines (about 20+ pts, 2+ reb, 4+ ast) could not be priced. Est true prob 0.63*0.60*0.62=0.234, shrunk for a tough matchup and small samples to 0.21 vs 0.211 implied (no SGP quote found): no edge, not highlighted.
Totals (method): pace avg (102.3 OKC, 102.8 SA; USU table) = 102.55. OKC = avg(117.6 ORtg, 111.3 SA DRtg) x 1.0255 = 117.4. SA = avg(119.6 ORtg, 106.5 OKC DRtg) x 1.0255 = 115.9. Projected total 233.3 vs DK 229.5 (market file), 230.5-233 elsewhere. The score model has OKC +1.5 before home court (~2 pts), so the side is close to a pick'em.
Injuries: SA out Tobias Harris (calf), Jayden Quaintance; OKC out Thomas Sorber, Nikola Topic, Otega Oweh. Holmgren (quad) off the report (NBC Sports); J. Williams and SGA healthy (Yahoo). Wembanyama starting (ESPN); an SI 'doubtful' note looks stale.
Lineups/coaching: Mitch Johnson starts Fox, Castle, Harper, Vassell, Wembanyama (ESPN). Daigneault runs a deep, switch-heavy rotation and the No. 1 defense (106.5 DRtg); OKC usually plays SGA ~33-35 min in openers.
History: SA won the 2026 WCF 4-3 (G7 111-103); series games were mostly low scoring, while Wemby averaged only 27.6 pts+reb in five 2025-26 regular-season meetings (Lineups.com).
Lines/market: ESPN DK SA -1.5, total 229.5 (o -115/u -105), SA -112/OKC -108. FanDuel SA -2.5, o231.5 -106, OKC +106/SA -123; Covers 231.5; bet365 232.5; theLines 233. The total has moved up since DK's 229.5.
Experts: Dimers SA 59% (ML -120); theLines SA ML, 121-117; SBR OKC +2.5 and Under 232; TheSpread SA -1.5 and Under 232.5; Winners and Whiners SA -1.5, Under 232.5 (117-113); Lineups.com Over 231.5 (117-115). Consensus: lean SA, split on total.
Props seen: Wemby pts 26.5 (o -114/u -120 SportsGambler), reb 11.5 (DK -119/-111, Hard Rock o -105); SGA pts 28.5 (-122), assists 6.5 (o +105); J. Williams pts 16.5-17.5; Castle 16.5; Fox 15.5.
Chemistry: both cores intact after a short offseason; SA added minutes for Harper and Castle; OKC gets J. Williams back after he missed the WCF.
